Official Plan Land use structure for Brampton Plan Schedule 1A.  Land Use Designations identify the general intended use and function of land throughout the city. These designations provide the framework for growth and development by directing where rCommunity Areas, Employment Areas, Natural Heritage System, Provincial Highways, and other land uses are permitted, helping to create complete and connected communities.
This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
